      "section": "mod-tome/data/zones/abashed-expanse/objects.lua",
      "source": "It looks like a very tiny star -- deep black -- and yet it somehow shines.",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "它看起来像是一颗非常小巧的星星——深邃而黑暗——却不知为何闪着光芒。"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "2c55e3bc8e50cec99cfb615eae4d4daf29cc36e9d384164751cc9ce9e8ee453a",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0137 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/texts/unlock-undead_skeleton.lua",
      "source": "Skeletons are evil undead creatures. Usually raised by Necromancers to serve as mindless servants, some manage to keep their sentience and roam the world in a blazing path of destruction.\nYou have killed the Master, a malevolent undead creature. You can now create a new character with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Skeleton race#WHITE#.\n\nRace features:#YELLOW#\n- Poison immunity\n- Bleeding immunity\n- Fear immunity\n- No need to breathe\n- Special skeleton talents: bone armour, resilient bones, re-assemble#WHITE#\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "骷髅是邪恶的不死亡灵。通常被死灵法师复活为无意识的仆从，但有些骷髅设法保留了意识，在世界上留下一条燃烧的毁灭之路。\n你杀死了领主，一个恶毒的不死亡灵。现在你在创建人物时可以选择新的种族：#LIGHT_GREEN#骷髅#WHITE#。\n\n种族特色：#YELLOW#\n- 毒素免疫\n- 流血免疫\n- 恐惧免疫\n- 无需呼吸\n- 特殊骷髅技能：骨质盔甲，弹力骨骼，重组#WHITE#\n"
    },
    {
      "args_order": null,
      "component": "tome",
      "entry_id": "73172788328bcbf6bbdf3eaf2d355c876277c172e5b9fd0336b47fb4309963c5",
      "notes": "Lite review batch 0137 host-confirmed edit",
      "section": "mod-tome/data/texts/unlock-wilder_summoner.lua",
      "source": "In the wilds, some people and creatures are able, by the sole force of their will, to call upon allies to help them in combat.\nYou have witnessed such an act and can now create new characters with the #LIGHT_GREEN#Summoner class#WHITE#.\n\nSummoners are Wilders, who are at home in the wilds and draw their power from their connection with nature.\nClass features:#YELLOW#\n- Summon allies, ranging from a war hound to the mighty fire drake\n- Take direct control of your summons\n- Augment your summons with various powers#WHITE#\n\nAll Wilder classes use Equilibrium for their powers. It represents their connection to nature. \nThe higher it gets the more off-balance they are with it. A high Equilibrium makes for a chance to fail to use a power and lose a turn.\n",
      "source_tag": "_t",
      "special": null,
      "target": "在野外，有些人和生物仅凭意志力，就能召唤盟友协助战斗。\n你已经见证了这种力量的存在，现在你可以在创建人物时选择新的职业：#LIGHT_GREEN#召唤师#WHITE#。\n\n召唤师属于野性系，以野外为家，与自然的联系是他们的力量来源。\n职业特点：#YELLOW#\n- 能召唤盟友，从战争猎犬到强大的火龙不等\n- 能直接控制你的召唤物\n- 使用不同的方式强化你的召唤物#WHITE#\n\n所有野性系职业使用自然失衡值作为其能量，它代表着他们与自然之间的联系。\n失衡值越高，他们与自然越不平衡。失衡值过高可能导致能力使用失败并损失一个回合。\n"
    }
  ],
